1479-4288-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4288-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

401-2530-3944-7452.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-7452.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

4770-6090-6723-7296.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1818-3899-5010-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-3899-5010-6900.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

147-2171-3899.easyPrerequisites: There's a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-3899.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-5686-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-5789.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5256-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 5.

877-3184-4645-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing The First Sliver.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot trigger.
Cast The First Sliver by paying {0}.
The First Sliver's cascade ability triggers, allowing you to cascade.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

654-3129-4094-4365-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-3129-4094-4365-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

301-4802-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

5641-5789-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-5789-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4460-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3129-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

104-1786-2541.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

3560-6797-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

413-3020-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
413-3020-6701.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Puppeteer Clique trigger, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the creature returned in step 5.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 4, untapping it.
Resolve the Szarel trigger from step 2, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1021-1669-5231-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-1669-5231-6761.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-1669-5231-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

325-3017-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-3017-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
325-3017-5796-6282.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

2105-3719-5231-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six creatures, excluding Combat Celebrant, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Combat Celebrant or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2105-3719-5231-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping six creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, adding {R}.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

3918-4002-4038.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
3918-4002-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

1987-2187-4276-4477.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2187-4276-4477.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and Possessed Skaab.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-4276-4477.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

333-2730-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.

874-2478-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
874-2478-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.

Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

1183-2249-4050.notablePrerequisites: Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1183-2249-4050.description:
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {1}.
When the Pentavite dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.

2877-2988-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
2877-2988-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 51 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

549-1376-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
549-1376-1978.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat

1295-2225-3202-4219-4926.description:
Cast Wingmantle Chaplain by paying {3}{W}.
Wingmantle Chaplain's ETB ability and Dormant Sliver each trigger.
Resolve Dormant Sliver's trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve Wingmantle Chaplain's trigger, creating a 1/1 Sliver token with defender for each creature with defender you control.
Wingmantle Chaplain's last ability and Dormant Sliver each trigger once for each token created; put them on the stack in any order.
Resolve a Dormant Sliver trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve a Wingmantle Chaplain trigger, creating a 1/1 Sliver token with defender.
Repeat steps 5 through 7 until there are no cards in your library.
Put Wingmantle Chaplain's and Dormant Sliver's triggers on the stack in any order.
In response, cast Savage Summoning by paying {G}.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield and triggers.

3153-3750.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {6}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
3153-3750.description:
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Sphinx of the Second Sun triggers, causing you to get an additional beginning phase after this phase.
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to the main phase from step 5.
At the beginning of the main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun triggers, causing you to get an additional beginning phase after this phase.
Move to the beginning phase from step 7, causing you to untap all lands you control and draw a card.
Move to the main phase from step 4.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-2265-3062-4050-5105.manaNeeded: {4} in at least three different colors
2060-2265-3062-4050-5105.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler giving it 5 +1/+1 counters because of Pir, Imaginative Rascal and harden scales.
Remove all five counters getting {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Sacrifice Crawler to Altar for one mana of any color.
Pay Sigil's cost of {1}{W} returning Crawler to hand.
Recast Crystalline Crawler for all of the remaining floating mana giving it six +1/+1 counters.
Remove all six counters netting {6} of assorted colors containing {W} {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Repeat steps 4-7 adding mana along the way.

335-1984-3096.manaNeeded: {3}{W}{B}{B} plus an additional {1}{U}{U}{U} available if Jace is not on the battlefield
335-1984-3096.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, revealing the top card of your library, putting that card into your hand and losing life equal to that card's mana value.
Repeat the process in step 3 until you have an empty library.
If Jace is in your hand, cast it by paying {1}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.
